sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: N UMEROUS applications require frequency-shift keying (FSK) demodulation at a very low modulation factor. One example is demodulation of a Gaussian FSK (GFSK) signal at an intermediate frequency (IF) in a heterodyne Bluetooth receiver, such as Atmel’s T2901 [1].
